detail.title: 8MP 42x Starlight Dual Light Network Panoramic PTZ Camera
detail.overview: Compare Favourite SDT8C842-8P-FA-APV-0280 8MP 42x Starlight Dual Light Network Panoramic PTZ Camera Key Points • Captures a Large Area and Great Details at the Same Time • High-Quality Imaging with 8MP Resolution for Overview Channel, 8MP for Detailed Channel • Expansive Night View with up to 300m IR Distance and 30m White Light • Face Recognition: Supports Face Information Collection, Property Expression Fetching, Face Database Management and Comparison • Enhanced Deep Learning-Based Human and Vehicle Classification • Supports PoE++ (802.3bt) for High-Power Delivery • IP67 for Protection Against Harsh Environments Sales Enquiry Datasheet

General.Image Sensor: Overview channel: 1/1.8" CMOS Detail channel: 1/1.8" CMOS
General.Pixel: Overview channel: 8 MP Detail channel: 8 MP
General.Min. Illumination: Overview channel: Color: 0.001 lux@F1.0 B/W: 0.0001 lux@F1.0 0 lux (Illuminator on) Detail channel: Color: 0.005 lux@F1.4 B/W: 0.0005 lux@F1.4 0 lux (Illuminator on)
General.Illuminator On/Off Control: Zoom Prio; Manual; Smart IR; Off
General.Illuminator Number: Overview channel: 4 (white light) Detail channel: 6 (IR), 2 (white light)
General.Focal Length: Overview channel: 2.8 mm Detail channel: 5.5 mm–231 mm
General.Max. Aperture: Overview channel: F1.0 Detail channel: F1.4-F4.5
General.Field of View: Overview channel: H: 200°; V: 50°; Detail channel: H: 61.8°–2.2°; V: 36.3°–1.3°; D: 69.2°–2.4°
General.Pan/Tilt Range: Overview channel: Tilt: +5° to +17°; Detail channel: Pan: 0° to 360° endless; Tilt: –30° to +90°
General.Video Metadata: Motor vehicle, non-motor vehicle, face, and human body detection; tracking; optimization; capturing pictures; uploading high-quality face snapshots; motor vehicle attributes; non-motor vehicle attributes; human body attributes; face attributes
General.IVS (Perimeter Protection): Tripwire; intrusion; climbing fences; loitering detection; abandoned/missing object; fast moving; parking detection; people gathering; vehicle/human alarm classification; linkage tracking
General.Face Recognition: Supports face detection, face bounding box, optimization, capturing snapshots, uploading high-quality face snapshots, enhancing face images and face exposure. Attribute extraction is also supported, where 6 attributes and 8 expressions can be detected. Face cutout is also offered, where you can cutout one face at a time and customize the size to be a one-inch photo. Supports up to 5 face databases; registers person one by one or in batches; sets face similarity; compares faces with 10,000 faces.
General.Intelligence Notes: Independent Intelligence: The panorama camera and the detail camera can run different types of intelligent functions. Panorama (only one function can be enabled at a time): Perimeter protection and video metadata (takes snapshots and recognizes the attributes of motor vehicles, non-motor vehicles and people). Detail (only one function can be enabled at a time): Face recognition, perimeter protection and video metadata (takes snapshots and recognizes the attributes of motor vehicles, non-motor vehicles and people). Linked Intelligence: For perimeter protection, the panoramic camera links with the detail camera to track targets.

General.Sound Warning: Offers 22 sound alarms and supports importing custom sound alarms.
